source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Captain America (Steve Rogers) (archived 10 July 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: The Super-Soldier Serum permanently raised every bodily function to the peak of human potential and let him survive decades frozen in ice.
Elite wartime training and decades of combat made him a master martial artist and one of the finest tacticians alive.
His near-indestructible shield, a one-off vibranium and proto-adamantium alloy, is his main weapon.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America's Shield

abilities.name: Super-Soldier physiology
abilities.detail: Strength, speed, stamina, agility and reflexes at the highest human level and slightly beyond, kept that way by the serum.

abilities.name: Master tactician
abilities.detail: Widely seen as one of the greatest battlefield strategists on Earth, able to rework a plan as a fight changes.

abilities.name: Master martial artist
abilities.detail: Blends boxing, judo, jujutsu, karate and other styles with gymnastics into his own acrobatic fighting style.

abilities.name: Shield mastery
abilities.detail: Throws the shield with near-perfect aim, ricochets it off several targets in one throw and judges its rebound almost to the millimetre.

abilities.name: Pressure-point strikes
abilities.detail: Precise nerve strikes can knock out or immobilise opponents, including superhumanly strong ones.

abilities.name: Worthy of Mjolnir
abilities.detail: Has been judged worthy to lift and wield Thor's enchanted hammer on several occasions.

feats.text: Fighting beside Thor against demons, he lifted Mjolnir and sent it back to Thor, proving himself worthy of the hammer.
Disguised as Crossbones in an A.I.M. arena, he beat General Wo and Razor Fist in turn, then took on a horde of villains.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 1 412

feats.text: With the Galactic Council ready to surrender, he planned a counterstrike that freed the captured Avengers and smashed much of the Builders' force.
Infiltrated a Hydra fortress alone, slipped past the guards and freed the captured Allied soldiers, Bucky Barnes among them.

feats.text: Beat an elevator full of STRIKE agents, broke a magnetic cuff, dropped several floors onto his shield and downed a Quinjet.
